intro.title: Modern Websites Built for Business Results, Not Just Vanity
paragraphs: Your website is the single most critical touchpoint in your sales pipeline. Yet, over 80% of corporate websites suffer from slow load times, bloated page-builders, confusing navigation, and weak technical SEO that silently drive high-intent prospects directly into the arms of competitors.

At 360CloudTech, we discard cookie-cutter WordPress themes and bloated monolithic code. We engineer high-velocity digital experiences using Next.js, React, modern Headless CMS, and cloud-native backends. Every site is custom-crafted to achieve sub-second load times, flawless responsiveness across 20+ device breakpoints, and enterprise-grade OWASP security.

As a global technology partner with offices in India and clients across North America, the UK, Europe, and Asia-Pacific, we offer a strategic dual-shore delivery model: world-class Silicon Valley engineering standards combined with round-the-clock (24/7) agile sprint momentum and maximum engineering efficiency. process.title: Our 6-Stage Web Engineering Lifecycle
process.subtitle: A structured, transparent framework designed to deliver high-converting websites on time and on budget.

steps.title: 1. Discovery & Technical Blueprint (Days 1–5)
steps.desc: We analyze your business objectives, target buyer personas, competitive landscape, and technical requirements to create an exhaustive information architecture, tech stack specification, and SEO keyword map.

steps.title: 2. High-Fidelity UI/UX & Interactive Prototyping (Days 6–15)
steps.desc: Our designers craft responsive wireframes and clickable Figma prototypes following modern design systems. We iterate based on your feedback until the look, feel, and conversion flows are pixel-perfect.

steps.title: 3. Clean Agile Development & Sprint Demos (Sprints 1–4)
steps.desc: We build with Next.js, TypeScript, and clean modular components. You get staging server access, bi-weekly sprint demos, and daily code commits so you always have full visibility into development velocity.

steps.title: 4. QA, Cross-Device & OWASP Security Audit
steps.desc: Our dedicated QA engineers test every user journey across 20+ real mobile, tablet, and desktop viewports, running automated regression suites, accessibility (WCAG 2.1) checks, and OWASP Top 10 vulnerability scans.

steps.title: 5. Core Web Vitals & Technical SEO Optimization
steps.desc: Before launch, we pre-warm server caches, compress assets into next-gen formats (AVIF/WebP), configure dynamic JSON-LD schemas, and optimize critical rendering paths to guarantee 90+ PageSpeed scores.

steps.title: 6. Zero-Downtime Deployment & 90-Day Hypercare
steps.desc: We manage DNS migration, SSL certification, and live deployment with zero downtime. After launch, our team provides 90 days of complimentary hypercare support to monitor metrics and ensure smooth operations.

faqs.title: Answers to Your Website Development Questions
faqs.subtitle: Clear, honest answers to help you evaluate your web development partner.

items.q: How do you scope and deliver a custom website development project?
items.a: Every project begins with a dedicated technical discovery session. Rather than using cookie-cutter estimates or generic templates, our senior architects evaluate your precise business requirements, feature roadmap, and performance criteria to provide a tailored, transparent milestone plan with zero hidden surprises.

items.q: How long will it take to build and deploy our website?
items.a: A high-performance corporate marketing website typically launches in 2 to 3 weeks. Custom web applications and eCommerce platforms take approximately 4 to 8 weeks, while large-scale enterprise platforms run across 8 to 12 weeks of structured two-week agile sprints with bi-weekly live staging demos.

items.q: How do you ensure our website ranks high on Google search results?
items.a: We build with an SEO-first architecture: server-side rendering (SSR) for instant crawler indexing, semantic HTML5 tags, optimized internal linking, next-gen WebP/AVIF image compression, sub-1.2s Largest Contentful Paint (LCP) performance, and automated Google Schema Markup (Organization, Service, BreadcrumbList, and FAQPage JSON-LD) to help you outrank competitors and capture Google Rich Snippets.

items.q: How does 360CloudTech support international clients across the US, UK, and India?
items.a: We operate a seamless dual-shore model. Our technical leadership and dedicated project managers provide daily overlapping hours across US Eastern/Pacific (EST/PST), UK (GMT), and Indian Standard Time (IST). We collaborate directly in your dedicated Slack or Microsoft Teams channels, hold weekly Zoom sprint demos, and provide continuous updates on Jira or Linear.

items.q: Will our website be optimized for mobile devices and Core Web Vitals?
items.a: Absolutely. Every website is engineered mobile-first and tested across 20+ physical screen sizes (iOS, Android, tablets, and desktops). We adhere strictly to Google's Core Web Vitals criteria, targeting 95+ PageSpeed scores, LCP under 1.2 seconds, Cumulative Layout Shift (CLS) near zero, and Interaction to Next Paint (INP) under 100 milliseconds.

items.q: Do we get 100% intellectual property (IP) and source code ownership?
items.a: Yes. Upon project milestones and completion, 100% of the intellectual property, design assets (Figma), source code repositories (GitHub/GitLab), and database schemas are transferred directly to you. We never use proprietary vendor lock-in or hidden licensing fees.

items.q: What happens after the website is launched? Do you offer maintenance?
items.a: Every project includes 90 days of complimentary post-launch hypercare warranty covering bug fixes, performance monitoring, and server maintenance. Beyond that, we offer flexible monthly maintenance and DevOps retainers that include 24/7 uptime monitoring, security updates, regular backups, and continuous feature enhancements.
